text: Hedge funds have the potential both to amplify and to mitigate systemic risk, and which effect dominates turns on their particular risk management incentives, leverage, and investment strategies, which is why the academic evidence remains mixed.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Timothy A. Krause, Hedge Funds and Systemic Risk (2016). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=2748096
abstract: Hedge funds may have the potential to amplify and/or mitigate systemic risks due to their particular risk management incentives, leverage, and investment strategies.

additionalProperty.name: scope_conditions
value: conclusion drawn from the mixed post-crisis literature
